visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width rotating promo banner at the top of the page
description: Full-width image-only promo banners with yellow pill CTA and dot pagination, autoplay

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: banner image (message text is baked into the art, keep alt text); cell 2 (optional): CTA link or label. Dots and 5s autoplay (paused on hover/focus and for reduced motion) are added by the block
notes: Rotating, auto-advancing banner slider with dot navigation is an interactive component; message text is baked into images, so each slide is image + CTA.

usage: Use for a page-top slider of image-only promo banners, each with an optional CTA.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any auto-advancing, image-led banner slider. For a single static banner use hero instead.
